english.title: Public service vehicle - passenger causing nuisance and refusing to leave

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: PUBLIC SERVICE VEHICLES CONDUCT OF DRIVERS

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), remained on the vehicle when directed to leave by the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[inspector]_
(C)_[conductor]_

on the grounds that you had been causing a nuisance
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1)(k)(ii) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.

date and location

english.notes:
(i) In addition to the above, regulation 6 deals with other forms of misconduct of passengers. In particular see H3187 Passenger failing to quit a PSV .
(ii) See section 68(1) of the Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 for defence.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) Further detail may be included in the Statement of Facts in relation to how the matter came to the attention of the police and any explanation given by the defendant.
